description: Appointment to the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of Ratnapura is currently vacant as Mr. K.G.S. Nishantha, who served as the District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Ratnapura, has been appointed to the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of Kegalle with effect from 2026-04-27. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to appoint Mr. M.G. Lalith Ananda, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to the post of District Secretary/Government Agent of Ratnapura with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.
